motion.name: ease-apple
motion.purpose: Standard kinetic easing for state transitions.

components.name: Primary Roll Button
components.description: Signature 3D roll button in Desert Titanium gold with kinetic hover roll.
components.css: .ds-btn-roll { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #B8824C 0%, #9E6B38 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 980px; border: 1px solid #8C5828; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(158, 107, 56, 0.28); } .ds-btn-roll:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(158, 107, 56, 0.35); }

components.name: Tactile Keycap
components.description: Physical tactile keycap with inset highlight and micro-depression on active click.
components.css: .ds-keycap { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #F5F5F7 100%); color: #1D1D1F; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 15px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); transition: all 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-keycap:hover { border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-keycap:active { transform: translateY(1.5px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); }

components.name: Floating Card Container
components.description: Pure ceramic white floating card with subtle hairline border and ambient shadow.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9E6B38; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1D1D1F; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #515154; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview: ALIGNX’s visual identity is modeled as a high-precision optical instrument. Rather than an aggressive gaming HUD or a generic corporate dashboard, ALIGNX feels like an architectural observatory where complex human psychometrics, parental expectations, and labor market telemetry are brought into crisp, unambiguous focus.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The Desert Titanium primary accent is reserved for top recommendations and primary affirmative actions (≤10% of surface area).

rules.name: The Double-Border Rule
rules.body: High-priority floating cards pair a 1px subtle outer border with an inner 1px inset highlight to create crisp material realism.

rules.name: The Monospace Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every primary section headline is prefaced by an uppercase monospace eyebrow badge in wide tracking providing taxonomic orientation.

rules.name: The Kinetic Easing Rule
rules.body: All state transitions utilize Apple-grade cubic bezier curve cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

dos: Do format all financial metrics with explicit Rupee denomination (e.g. ₹8.5L, ₹25,000/mo).
Do preface complex quantitative scores with diagnostic status badges.
Do maintain high typographic contrast between headings and metadata labels.
Do use var(--ease-apple) for all interactive transitions.
donts: Don't use neon or saturated purple/green cyberpunk palettes; ALIGNX is an authoritative, architectural observatory.
Don't display black-box percentages without the underlying 5D dimensional breakdown.
Don't use sharp 0px corners on interactive buttons; use the signature 980px pill radius.
Don't allow slider handles to overlap labels on mobile viewports.
